To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) MBPTA requires that the hardware architecture be designed in such a way that the execution time of a program is a function only of the input data; (2) MBPTA also requires that the execution time be predictable and bounded; (3) MBPTA does not require the architecture to be deterministic; (4) MBPTA is not compatible with speculative execution.
